title.value: Draft and maintain resale listings when clearing a closet

introduction.value: A user has Claude handle pricing, copy, drafting, maintenance, and discounting of online listings while selling items from their closet.

method.value: The poster gives Claude a folder of item photos and has it handle nearly the full resale workflow: price research, copywriting, data entry, and creating draft listings on five platforms for the person to publish. They also use it for listing maintenance and discounting, and are still building the skills that manage active listings and adjust strategy for items that do not sell.

outcome.value: They say Claude has been very useful for clearing out a closet and offloading the busywork, but they are not sure it actually saves time yet. The tradeoff is that manual listing work gets replaced by creating and maintaining Claude skills.

notes.value: The main catch is upkeep: they are still working on the skills for maintenance and discounting, so the system is not yet hands-off.

Copy prompt
I'm clearing out my closet and selling on [Poshmark/eBay/Depop]. For each item I paste below (brand, size, condition, original price), suggest a competitive price, write a title and description, and give a discount plan if it hasn't sold in [number] days.
